label: EURJPY cross-asset 5-day daily momentum into RTH (February filter) true 5R
researchSummary: Cross-asset validation of `EURCHF 5-day daily momentum into RTH (February filter)`. Tests short-horizon own-return continuation/reversal inspired by time-series momentum literature. Filtered by signalMonth=2. Cross-asset rerun uses true bracket target/stop at 5:1 planned reward-to-risk.
selectionMethod: Fast cross-asset true-RR validation: existing bracket pattern was evaluated on a different asset with pre-2022 train diagnostics, post-2022 strict anti-cheat forward validation, bootstrap checks, and same-asset trade-overlap rejection. Management sweep promoted `be_trail_hourly_pivot_b4` only after strict forward PF improved from 2.21 to 2.57.
verificationSummary: Management sweep `be_trail_hourly_pivot_b4` strict PF 2.57 over 98 trades, beating baseline PF 2.21; train PF 0.81, bootstrap p05 1.61, block-bootstrap p05 1.89, odd/even min PF 2.23, annual pass rate 100%.
